biotools.summary: LiftOn is a homology-based lift-over tool that integrates DNA-DNA and protein-DNA alignments to improve genome annotation accuracy, particularly for eukaryotic species. It enhances annotation by maximizing protein-coding genes and finding additional gene copies.
